summary: MetaVia Inc. furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 on September 9, 2026, disclosing preclinical results for DA-1726 rather than any corporate transaction. The study showed subcutaneously administered DA-1726-derived radioactivity is slowly absorbed and broadly distributed, with highest tissue exposure in adipose tissue, elevated tissue-to-plasma ratios over time, and detection through the 144-hour final assessment, supporting once-weekly dosing. Minimal central nervous system radioactivity was observed. No stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or deal mechanics were disclosed. The filing is a routine product-development update, not a special situation; watch for subsequent clinical milestones.
